description: This Java source file defines the class 'UsernamePasswordCredentials', a helper class used for parsing and representing username/password credentials for device authentication within the Hono framework. It provides static factory methods to create credential objects based on whether the system is in single-tenant or multi-tenant mode, handling parsing of usernames with tenant IDs.

classes.name: UsernamePasswordCredentials
classes.description: A helper class that encapsulates username/password credentials for device authentication, capable of handling single-tenant and multi-tenant configurations, and providing access to credentials properties.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate credentials with provided username and password, considering tenant mode (single or multi-tenant). Parses tenant ID from username if in multi-tenant mode.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns a constant string indicating the type of credentials, specifically a hashed password type.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password associated with these credentials for verification.
